featured_reviews.name: Suryaprakash Barnwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the privilege of visiting Sri Guru Nanak Darbar in Mira Road East on the occasion of Baisakhi, and it was truly a soul-stirring experience. The entire gurdwara was beautifully decorated, creating a warm and festive atmosphere that instantly lifted my spirits.

From the moment I stepped in, there was a sense of peace and spiritual calm. The kirtan was deeply moving, and the energy of the sangat coming together in celebration of such a significant day in Sikh history was heartening. The Baisakhi celebrations were well-organized, with traditional hymns, prayers, and a sense of togetherness that reminded me of the true essence of community and seva.

The langar was served with immense love and humility – simple yet wholesome, just as it should be. I could see volunteers of all ages working selflessly, which added to the sense of unity and devotion.

Overall, the visit to Sri Guru Nanak Darbar on Baisakhi left a lasting impression on me. It’s a place where faith, peace, and community come together beautifully. I highly recommend visiting, especially during such auspicious occasions.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I have personally visited Gurdwaras not just on Baisakhi Gurpurab and other auspicious occasions but also on days when i really needed some positivity to feel better.
I visited this Gurdwara Sahib on Gurpurab 2020 and i felt nothing but positivity and peace all around. The minimalistic yet clean decor was elegant and respectable.
In the end, the Kadha Prasad was given in a plastic zip bag and that effort was very commendable considering the new levels of hygiene and safety required with the ongoing pandemic. The cleanliness is commendable and hope they can maintain it the same way even with multiple devotees flocking the holy place around the clock.

It has opened doors to the realm of spirituality in my life...... I can't thank God enough to help me find my place of Solace.... Satnaam Sri Waheguru g..... waheguru g ka khalsa waheguru g ki fateh..... 🙏🙏🙏🙏Ik Onkaar

featured_reviews.name: Balveer Kaur
featured_reviews.review_text:
Have been staying in front of this gurudwara for some time. I have seen so many working  men and  women come here and take blessings 5 am in the morning and leave after having tea and snacks.
Langar is provided 3 times a day daily. I have never seen any one leaving this place hungry.

featured_reviews.name: Alok Tiwari
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am not that big to rate this place. But every holy place is peaceful place to be at.
This one was away from my eyes being in vicinity since almost past 3-4 years.
Got to know about this place last week only and I gave a visit.
Like almost all Gurdwara this is also huge one and multistory.
Ground floor has show racks, water for getting clean.
1st floor has main Darshan.
I used to travel regularly through this place but didn't notice as it has big wall boundary and way to Darshan is next to it.
It might need a bit renovation (coloring) outside.
Rest All is Peace.

featured_reviews.name: Surinder Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very peaceful place to visit. Cozy medium sized holy place as compared to lot of other Gurudwaras.
The place is very quit, neat, clean and very well maintained.
Lot of positive vibes that you feel the inner peace.
Community kitchen is open every Sunday morning and people from different faith participate in the seva.

featured_reviews.name: Kanhaiya Singh Sudan
featured_reviews.review_text: Good green will maintain. All free benefits drinking water, washroom for gente& ladies & also cooled minds place.

featured_reviews.name: Nanak Hotwani
featured_reviews.review_text: Road work is going on by TMC so entry from main door is closed. you have to go from behind and the approach road is very narrow and not visible. however the authorities told me that work will get over in 15 days and then you can use the main door which is next to HDFC Bank

featured_reviews.name: Nitya Sudhakaran
featured_reviews.review_text: It's a beautiful Gurudwara located in Mulund colony ,its spacious.Was surprised to note that it was huge place which could not be known from outside.Had langar on a Sunday it was superb.The Prasad was tasty.Its peaceful ,awesome vibe felt blessed was able to visit this place.Do visit if you get the chance.

featured_reviews.name: Gurvinder Grover
featured_reviews.review_text:
My spritual retreat 🔆✨✳️ situated at an altitude, this spritual place is quite spacious and divine ✨✨
Has a huge langar hall, huge prayer hall, medical room and also a separate marriage hall.
Langar here is just divinely delicious ✳️
Every Sunday at 12.00 pm, langar starts. At 8.00 am kirtan starts.
A must visit place.
An important aspect is that it's a historical place. Shri Guru nank dev ji visited here  and blessed this place 🙏🙏

featured_reviews.name: Shrestha Mitra
featured_reviews.review_text:
It's in mukund,and u should have ur maps in to locate this place as it's through narrow lanes,but for peace and prayer lord is same🙏
My friend had arranged her wedding here and it was managed well

featured_reviews.name: fr gh
featured_reviews.review_text:
situated in a tight narrow lane wher if ur driving skills r questionable it wld b a.problem ....
but once inside .... ahh now that's a different mattr ... peace n serenity reign in this large hall wher the priest recites frm the holy book of the sikhs .. the guru granth sahib ...
a vry vry well respected and disciplined religion the gurudwara welcums ppl of every faith ...

featured_reviews.name: Supinder Singh Gill
featured_reviews.review_text: Awesome Holy Place. Vibes are always good here. Every sunday langar (guru da langar/prashad). Stay blessed and calm. Do visit and seek the same. Wedding Hall and food for the people is available at this place as per the requirement .Everything is perfect here 🕌🙏🇮🇳

featured_reviews.name: Rosy Kohli
featured_reviews.review_text:
Went for a pray meeting , Gurudwara is inside & slope is there ,At present repair work is going on inside the Gurudwara.There is no parking space u have to park near by.Very spaces Gurudwara & hall.
Only they should see the washroom should be kept clean.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Salave
featured_reviews.review_text: Sri Guru Nanak Darbar situated on Dr Rajendra Prasad Marg, one if the nice Gurudwara in Mulund, they are conducting so many function and spiritual activities in there premisses. Please avoid car if you are visiting this place as there is parking problem.
